faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar X-Type 2.1 V6 use?
faqLeft.a: The X-Type 2.1 V6 uses the AJ20 - a 2.1-litre V6 petrol engine derived from the Ford Duratec family. It was fitted from 2001 to 2009 across the X400 generation.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar X-Type 2.1 V6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,600. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my X-Type 2.1 V6?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the AJ20 V6 engine before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ20 X-Type 2.1 V6 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace ignition coils, valve cover gaskets, timing chain components and bearings as standard on every AJ20 V6 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used X-Type 2.1 V6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my X-Type if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an X-Type 2.1 V6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most X-Type owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
